metadata.scenario: A hospital discharge planner calls for the first time asking about CareFirst's service area, whether they accept Medicare Part A, and what documentation is needed for a referral. Purely informational, no appointment or quote. Professional tone. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How may I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. My name is Patricia Wilson, and I'm calling because I was referred by Dr. Anderson regarding my mother’s upcoming hip replacement. Hello, Patricia. It's great to hear from you. How can I help regarding your mother’s care? I’m looking for information about post-surgery care services you offer and whether you accept Medicare Part A. Absolutely. We do provide post-surgery recovery care, which would be ideal for your mother. We do accept Medicare Part A for eligible services. That’s good to know. Could you tell me what documentation is needed for a referral? Certainly! For a referral, we typically require a physician's order, any relevant medical history, and insurance information. Okay, that sounds manageable. What specific services would you recommend after her hip replacement? I would recommend our Post-Surgery Recovery Care, which includes assistance with daily activities and monitoring her health as she recovers. Great. How long do those sessions usually last? Each session typically lasts between one to three hours, depending on her needs. And what’s the cost for that service? The pricing for Post-Surgery Recovery Care ranges from $85 to $110 per visit. Understood. Is there a specific service area you cover? We serve the greater Wichita area and its surrounding communities. Perfect! One last question—if I need to follow up, what’s the best way to reach you? You can reach me directly at +13165559201, or call our main line at +13165559200. Thank you for that, Margaret. I appreciate your help today. You're very welcome, Patricia! Feel free to reach out if you have any further questions. I will. Have a great day! You too! Take care.
